title: Mixed Event — Imprisoned Marionette — Episode6 Dreaming Doll

meta.Event Outline: To fulfill her promise to Mafuyu, Kanade wants to learn more about her. Meanwhile, the group visits a doll exhibit, where Mafuyu has a strange experience.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why is it all dark? I thought I was doing some work in my room...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(I can't move...?
Or talk, or open my eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Isn't this the doll exhibit we visited today? What am I doing here?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at that, Ena!
Isn't it amazing?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, it's very well done.
It almost feels alive.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Why does it feel like they're talking about me?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, this doll has strings attached to it.
Is it a marionette or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! I wish we could make it move around! I'm guessing it'd be pretty hard considering the size of this thing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't touch it, Mizuki. It looks really expensive.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, that doll over there's super cute too♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I told you to stop running around!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Is that why I can't move?
That's impossible...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't mind. Being a doll, that is.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It means I don't have to do anything or think anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't have to look for myself anymore. I just need to do as I'm told.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Everyone will be happier that way, right...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You're feeling something right now.
Tell me what it is.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you want to know?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I can't feel anything.
How many times do I have to say it?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And even if I did feel something, nobody would care...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Tell me what you're feeling, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, it's me. I thought you went to sleep.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh. I logged into Nightcord and then fell asleep.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <A dream about me turning into a doll...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I turned into that disgusting doll we saw at the exhibit today, and I couldn't move or talk.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <But then you appeared in front of me, and...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And? What was I doing in there?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't remember... I think you were trying to say something to me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I see...
And how did that dream make you feel?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, but I really want to know...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I want to see things from your point of view and understand your feelings, because then I'll be one step closer to writing a song that will save you.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Since I don't even understand myself very well.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just don't understand. I live my life every day, but nothing gives me pleasure or joy.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yet I can sense that something vital is missing.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <How do I even put this into words?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I feel closer to her this way than when we're having a conversation.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If she can't put her feelings into words properly, then...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <How about you put it into lyrics?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Lyrics are words too, but I also believe they're a little different.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You don't have to explain yourself or try to understand them.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Just turn what you're feeling now into song lyrics.>
